tap dev: one MCP server that stands in for all of yours.

Usage
  tap                                  serve MCP over stdio; this is what an agent starts
  tap COMMAND [ARGUMENT...] [FLAG...]  everything else

Examples
  tap import
  tap add docs https://docs.example.com/mcp
  tap add files -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem ~/notes
  tap list
  tap search create issue
  tap call files.read_text_file path=~/notes/todo.md

Servers
  import  bring over the servers your agents already have
  add     add a server
  remove  remove a server
  list    show the servers and how many tools each has
  auth    sign in to a server

Tools
  search  find tools, the way your agent does
  call    call a tool

More than one machine
  remote  share one set of servers between machines

Other
  path     print the config file tap reads
  version  print the version
  help     show help for tap or one command

Flags
  -h, --help     show help for tap or for a command
      --version  print the version
      --json     print JSON instead of text (import, list, search, call)
      --local    use this machine's servers while a remote is selected

Environment
  TAP_CONFIG        the config file (default ~/.tap/servers.json)
  TAP_DEADLINE_MS   how long a server may take to connect and list its tools (default 5000)
  TAP_REMOTE_TOKEN  the token a remote and its clients share
  NO_COLOR          set to print help without bold headings

Run "tap COMMAND --help" for a command's examples and flags.
Docs:   https://github.com/fschrhunt/tap/tree/main/docs
Issues: https://github.com/fschrhunt/tap/issues
